mapper.select: SELECT general_member.id AS generalMemberId , general_member.nickName , general_member.profileImg , review.id AS reviewId , review.reviewTitle , review.reviewText , review.point , review.updatedAt AS `reviewUpdatedAt` FROM `general_member` JOIN `review` ON general_member.id = review.generalMemberId WHERE review.productId = #{productId} ORDER BY review.updatedAt DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
